description: BriqLab Scroller is an animated ticker-tape visual for Microsoft Power BI, designed to display scrolling KPI values, stock-style price tickers, headlines, or any custom text in a compact, always-visible banner. It is ideal for dashboards that need to surface multiple data points in minimal screen space. Key features: 1.Smooth continuous scroll animation with configurable speed and direction 2.Supports Category + Value + Change measure for stock/KPI ticker format 3.Custom Text mode — scroll any free-text message without data binding 4.Colour-coded change indicators: green for positive, red for negative 5.Configurable separator character between items 6.Adjustable font size, font family, and background colour 7.Pause-on-hover option 8.Click any ticker item to cross-filter other visuals on the report page 9.Right-click any item for the Power BI context menu 10.Dynamic tooltips on each item showing label, value, and change 11.Fully responsive — adapts to any viewport width or height How to use: 1.Add a Category field as the item label 2.Add a Value measure for the numeric display 3.Optionally add a Change measure for up/down indicators 4.Or enable Custom Text in the Format pane to type scrolling text directly 5.Adjust speed, direction, font, and colours in the Format pane
